title: Functions [Practice - abs]
description:
## Testing Functions
From now on, some lessons will test your functions automatically. You write the function, the test code calls it for you. Note that if section .text / .data isnt there, don't write it, it is auto appended. If it is their, you probably need to use it.


---
## Assignment:
Write a function called `abs_val` that takes a number in `rdi` and returns its absolute value in `rax`.

- If `rdi` is negative, negate it
- If `rdi` is positive or zero, return it as-is

Hint: `neg rax` flips the sign of rax.
setupCode:
section .data
    pass_msg db "PASS", 10
    pass_len equ $ - pass_msg
    fail_msg db "FAIL", 10
    fail_len equ $ - fail_msg

section .text
    global _start
starterCode:
abs_val:
    ; return absolute value of rdi in rax
    ret
runHarness:
_start:
    mov rdi, -5
    call abs_val
    cmp rax, 5
    jne .fail1
    mov rdi, 3
    call abs_val
    cmp rax, 3
    jne .fail2
    mov rdi, 0
    call abs_val
    cmp rax, 0
    jne .fail3
    ; all passed
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, pass_msg
    mov rdx, pass_len
    syscall
    jmp .exit
.fail1:
.fail2:
.fail3:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rdi, 1
    mov rsi, fail_msg
    mov rdx, fail_len
    syscall
.exit:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall
